fact: In August 2020 the ministries of Justice and Communications were finishing a strategy to digitise the justice system whose first aim is to link police stations electronically to the Public Prosecution and the courts; the ministries of Justice, Interior and Communications and the Public Prosecution take part, and the law-enforcement project is to integrate with the police stations' system and the prosecution's system, the President having directed two days earlier that the law-enforcement system be completed quickly.
title: القصة الكاملة لربط أقسام الشرطة بالنيابات والمحاكم إلكترونيا
